lead: Open with one line in your own voice. Who are you, in a sentence?

blocks.body:
Where do you come from, and how did you find design? Two short paragraphs.

Be specific. One detail only you could write is worth more than a list of adjectives.

blocks.heading: How I work
blocks.body: What do you care about in your work? What do you do that others don’t?

blocks.heading: What I’m looking for
blocks.body: The kind of role and team you want, the work that interests you most, when you are available and where you can work.

blocks.heading: Outside the studio
blocks.body: Two or three things you do when you are not designing. Choose the ones that say something about how you see the world.
